jobs.occupation: Cost Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
place of employment - Lummen

Jobomschrijving

Cost Engineering Specialist – Lummen Region

For a fast-growing international manufacturing company in the Lummen region, we are looking for a Cost Engineering Specialist.

Your responsibilities
	
• Prepare product cost calculations and sales pricing based on customer requirements, commercial agreements, and market conditions.	
• Maintain and update costing models and pricing data to ensure accuracy and competitiveness.	
• Identify cost-saving opportunities, improve margins, and support pricing strategies with data-driven analyses.	
• Collaborate with commercial and supply chain teams on customer negotiations, supplier pricing, and cost optimization initiatives.	
• Drive continuous improvement projects to increase efficiency, accuracy, and process performance.	
• Support planning, resource coordination, and the achievement of departmental objectives.	
• Contribute to quality management activities, audits, customer claim investigations, and corrective action follow-up.
This role combines cost analysis, pricing strategy, profitability improvement, supplier cost management, continuous improvement, and quality support to drive sustainable business performance.

Your Profile:

Education
	
• Bachelor's degree in:	
• Economics	
• Finance	
• Engineering	
• Or a related discipline.
Experience
	
• Experience in a similar costing, pricing, finance, engineering, or analytical role.	
• Experience within an international or multinational environment is a strong asset.	
• Understanding of manufacturing processes and production environments.	
• Knowledge of supply chain processes and product lifecycle costing.
Technical Skills
	
• Strong analytical and numerical capabilities.	
• Good understanding of:	
• Manufacturing processes	
• Production equipment	
• Cost structures	
• Supply chain dynamics	
• Product design processes	
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly:	
• Excel	
• PowerPoint	
• Word	
• Outlook	
• Teams
Languages
	
• Good spoken and written English.
Personal Competencies
	
• Analytical and detail-oriented.	
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness.	
• Able to understand and influence key profitability drivers.	
• Proactive and solution-oriented.	
• Comfortable communicating complex information in a clear and straightforward manner.	
• Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.	
• Committed to quality, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

jobs.occupation: AP Manager
jobs.description:
A strong financial profile with people management skills and a passion for process optimisation? As an AP Manager at Lotus Bakeries, you will have the opportunity to take on a key role within an international environment in Lembeke.

In this versatile role, you will combine people management with operational responsibility and process optimisation. You will have the freedom to take initiative, implement improvements and contribute to building efficient and future-proof Accounts Payable processes.

 

 

 

 

 

 

Your responsibilities:

As an AP Manager, you will be responsible for Accounts Payable services across multiple entities and countries.

• Lead, coach and develop the AP team (9 people), allocate workloads and ensure efficient operations and continuity.
• Coordinate the entire AP flow, from invoice receipt, processing and approval through to payments and supplier management, while ensuring process quality and timely execution.
• Monitor KPIs and SLAs, analyse workload and performance, and take action where necessary to further improve service delivery.
• Act as the first point of contact for complex AP matters and work closely with Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Treasury and external stakeholders.
• Ensure compliance with accounting policies, tax and legal requirements, as well as internal controls, and support internal and external audits.
• Analyse AP and cash management processes, including payment timing, DPO and cash discounts, and initiate concrete improvements.
• Identify opportunities for automation and process optimisation and contribute to finance transformation and system projects, such as SAP, VIM and Concur.
 

 

Your profile:

• You hold a Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or an equivalent field, combined with at least 5 years of relevant experience in AP or Accounting, preferably within an international or shared services environment.
• You have experience in people management and know how to coach, motivate and further develop a team.
• You have strong knowledge of AP accounting, VAT and invoice-to-pay processes, as well as experience with ERP systems; knowledge of SAP and VIM is a plus.
• You are analytical and KPI-driven, with strong knowledge of MS Excel and standard Office tools.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• You are organised, proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to set priorities effectively in a dynamic FMCG environment.
• You are a strong communicator with a stakeholder-oriented mindset and identify with values such as team spirit, open dialogue and passion.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Take the next step in your accounting career within a growing healthcare environment. An exciting opportunity is available for a Senior Accountant seeking a varied role with regional exposure across the Benelux. This position offers the chance to combine accounting expertise, financial reporting, tax compliance, and process improvement while contributing to an organisation dedicated to improving quality of life through healthcare solutions.

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several Benelux entities.
• Process purchase invoices, bank transactions, payroll entries, and general ledger postings.
• Perform monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities.
• Prepare and execute supplier payments.
• Assist with VAT returns, Intrastat declarations, and tax-related filings.
• Support the preparation of annual accounts and audit documentation.
• Review and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances.
• Handle HR-related administrative tasks for selected entities.
• Contribute to financial projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Provide support on ad hoc accounting and reporting activities.

About You

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• You have at between 4 and 10 years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, or controlling.
• You possess solid knowledge of Belgian accounting regulations; knowledge of Luxembourg and Dutch accounting standards is an asset.
• You have experience with audits, tax compliance, and financial controls.
• You work confidently with Excel and the MS Office suite.
• You are familiar with ERP systems; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a strong advantage.
• You have a good understanding of VAT and corporate tax regulations within the Benelux region.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and French, with a good command of English.
• You demonstrate strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
• You manage deadlines effectively and can prioritize multiple responsibilities.
• You work autonomously while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
• You take a proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges.
• You handle sensitive financial information with integrity and discretion.
• You explain financial data clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: Truck Mechanic Wanted – Build Your Career as a Commercial Vehicle Technician!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you are the technical expert who keeps our fleet of DAF trucks in top condition. You perform accurate diagnostics and repairs, carry out maintenance, and see electrical issues as challenges rather than problems. With your technical expertise, especially in electronics and vehicle technology, you are an indispensable part of the team.

An average workday starts with analyzing diagnostic reports. You read wiring diagrams, test wiring harnesses and control units, and carry out repairs according to the latest technical updates from the manufacturer. You communicate clearly with customers and the manufacturer about the work you perform. Additionally, you lead and support fellow mechanics and provide technical assistance to our branch in Herent as needed.

Are you ready to further develop your technical skills and take on a key role in a growing team? Apply now and give your career as a truck mechanic a powerful boost!

What we ask:

• Technical secondary education (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent through experience

• Professional bachelor's degree in Automotive Technology or equivalent is a plus

• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience as a truck or commercial vehicle mechanic

• Solid basic knowledge of electronics and experience in the automotive sector

• Ability to read electrical diagrams and analyze malfunctions

• Leadership skills and ability to coordinate a team

• Motivated, hands-on, and responsible

• C(E) driving license is an advantage but not required

• Good command of English (spoken)

• Available for day shift or 2-shift system

jobs.occupation: Production Operator - Immediate Start in a Growing Coatings Company
jobs.description:
Your Role

As a Production Operator Coatings, you are hands-on in the entire coatings production process. You ensure every batch is produced accurately and safely, from raw material to finished product.

What You Will Do

• Prepare raw materials and equipment

• Accurately weigh and add ingredients following recipes

• Operate and monitor mixing installations

• Closely follow mixing parameters (temperature, timing, method)

• Take samples and assist with quality controls

• Register production and quality data accurately

• Fill finished coatings into packaging and check weights

• Label and palletize finished products

• Keep machines and workstations clean and safe

• Report issues or deviations promptly

• Support your colleagues and be flexible within production

A Typical Day

You start the day by preparing materials and checking your workstation. Throughout the day, you follow set procedures for mixing and quality control, keep accurate records, and communicate any issues to your team leader. You end your shift with a tidy workplace and clear handover for the next day.

Ready to grow with us?

If you are looking for a varied, responsible role in production and want to be part of an ambitious team, we encourage you to apply!

• Minimum a few years of experience in a production environment (mixing, weighing, quality control)

• Experience with paint, coatings, chemical products, or mixing is a strong advantage

• Physically able to regularly lift weights up to 25kg

• B driving license required; willing to occasionally drive to Brussels

• Forklift experience for handling heavy pallets

• Very good command of English; understanding of Dutch is an asset

• Flexible, all-round team player

• Motivated for a long-term collaboration

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Microsoft 365 Consultant Junior
jobs.description:
Location: [Braine / Gent / Mechelen / Customer / Hybrid / Remote]

Contract: [Full-time / Freelance]

Experience: 0-3 years

Department: Microsoft 365 AI Business Solutions

Start: [As soon as possible]
About the role

As a Junior Microsoft 365 Consultant, you'll deliver projects end‑to‑end with guidance from senior colleagues where needed. You'll co‑create roadmaps, implement governance, contribute to architecture, run content migrations, drive user adoption, and build intranets and lightweight applications (SPFx or Power Platform basics). You're hands‑on, structured, and comfortable facilitating workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
What you'll do

• Roadmapping & value realization (co‑ownership):

• Contribute to maturity assessments and propose phased roadmaps aligned to business goals (collaboration, knowledge, security, AI readiness)

• Translate plans into backlogs, milestones, and success metrics (adoption, governance KPIs)

• Governance (collaboration, content & apps):

• Implement governance controls for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive: naming, lifecycle, provisioning, guest access, external sharing

• Help set up request & approval flows, templates, and site owner responsibilities; contribute to CoE practices

• Architecture (contribution & implementation):

• Contribute to tenant/site architectures (hub/site topology, Entra ID patterns) and information architecture (metadata, content types, navigation, audience targeting)

• Support solution architecture for basic SPFx and Power Platform solutions; follow environment strategy and basic ALM guidance

• Data migrations & modernization:

• Plan and execute content migrations (SharePoint Server, file shares, classic → modern) using tools like Shargate or custom PowerShell scripting

• Perform quality controls on executed migrations

• Perform content discovery, mapping, permissions & version remediation, pilot/cutover, and post‑migration validation with clear runbooks

• User adoption & change enablement:

• Co‑lead adoption activities: use‑case discovery, champions network, training, comms, and enablement assets

• Track impact via Adoption Score and usage analytics; iterate based on feedback

• Intranets & employee experience:

• Build SharePoint Online intranets: structure (hubs), page templates, audience targeting, search tuning, and governance for site owners

• Configure Viva Connections basics (dashboard, resources) when applicable

• Applications in m365 (SPFx & power platform - basics):

• Deliver lightweight solutions:

• SPFx: simple web parts/extensions for UI, branding, or navigation widgets

• Power Platform: Power Apps (canvas basics) and Power Automate flows for approvals and process automation

• Apply secure‑by‑default practices (permissions, data protection, DLP awareness) and document solutions

• Operations, documentation & handover:

• Produce solution docs, runbooks, admin guides; perform handover to operations and site owners

• Contribute to presales (effort estimates, scoping notes) with support from senior team members

• Already an experience delivering Microsoft 365 projects across governance, information architecture, content migrations, intranets, and user adoption

• Solid hands‑on with SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and familiarity with Entra ID (identity & access basics, Conditional Access patterns)

• Lightweight app skills (one or both):

• 

• SPFx basics (TypeScript/React fundamentals for web parts/extensions), and/or

• Power Platform basics (Power Apps, Power Automate, environment usage, simple ALM)

• Nice to have / Plus:

•  PowerShell for administration & automation (PnP or Graph exposure)

• Purview fundamentals (sensitivity labels, retention, basic DLP concepts) and ability to collaborate with security/compliance teams

• Strong workshop facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder communication

• Languages: English + Dutch and/or French (one of the two national language is mandatory)

• Certifications (nice to have): MS‑102, MD‑102, MS‑700, SC‑900/200/300/400, MS‑900, PL‑900 (or equivalent experience)

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Technician (Fixed Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

jobs.occupation: Line supervisor
jobs.description:
As a Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you are the key figure in the packaging department. You lead a motivated team and ensure that the machines perform optimally and the final products leave the facility perfectly packaged. You work closely with the production manager and planning department in a clean, high-tech, and fast-paced work environment where no two days are the same.

In the role of Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you carry the responsibility for the entire packaging process. Your concrete tasks include:

• Process Monitoring: You correctly start up and guide the packaging process from A to Z to guarantee an efficient flow.
• Team Leadership: You coordinate, motivate, and guide the team on the packaging floor.
• Quality & Hygiene: You ensure strict compliance with quality standards and hygiene regulations within the food sector.
• Problem Solving: You quickly resolve operational issues and malfunctions, and continuously look for process optimizations.
• Reporting: You report directly to the production manager regarding progress, results, and any bottlenecks.
• Communication & Planning: You check packaging orders and streamline communication between production planning and the storage of the finished product.
• Digitalization: You assist with the further rollout and everyday use of the MES & ERP systems on the packaging floor.
To be successful as a Line Supervisor 2-shifts or experienced packaging team leader, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

• Experience: You have experience within a production environment, ideally in the food industry.
• Leadership & Insight: You have technical insight and possess the natural ability to manage and motivate an operational team.
• Flexibility: You are a real go-getter with a flexible mindset who is happy to work in a fixed 2-shift system.
• Communication: You have a good command of the English language (for communication on the work floor).
• IT Skills: You have good computer skills and quickly pick up new software (such as ERP or MES).

jobs.occupation: Production worker (meat)
jobs.description:
As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.
